pill.zh: AI 产品经理 · 制造业 AI 落地
pill.en: AI Product Manager · Manufacturing AI Applications

sub.zh: 4 年制造业产品经验 + AI 产品转型。专注 AI 在垂直行业的真实落地：质检 · RAG · 时序预测。理解 AI 能力边界，擅长 AI + 人工协同方案。
sub.en: 4 years in manufacturing product, then AI transition. Focused on real-world vertical AI deployment: QC · RAG · time-series forecasting. Pragmatic about AI's limits — believer in AI + human collaboration.

title.zh: 在制造业，把 AI 真正用起来
title.en: Making AI Actually Work in Manufacturing

lead.zh: 4 年制造业产品经验后看到 AI 在垂直行业的落地机会，系统学习 AI 产品知识并成功转型。理解 AI 不是万能的、技术有边界 — 做的 3 个 AI 项目都是在深入理解业务痛点后，找到 AI 能真正解决问题的切入点：质检 AI+人工协同、RAG 知识库、时序预测采购建议。希望把 AI 真正用起来解决业务问题，而不是为了 AI 而 AI。
lead.en: After 4 years in manufacturing product, I spotted real vertical AI opportunities and systematically retrained into AI product. AI has limits — all 3 of my AI projects started from a deep business pain point and found where AI genuinely solves it: AI+human QC, RAG knowledge base, time-series purchasing. I want AI to actually solve business problems, not AI for AI's sake.

desc.en: Designed product solutions for smart customer service and RAG Q&A. Systematic AI product capabilities for transitioning into AI PM.

title.zh: 从碳纤维制造业，到 AI 落地。
title.en: From carbon fiber, to making AI work.

lead.zh: 在欧亚瑞新材料从普通产品经理做起，4 年完成从制造业产品到 AI 产品经理的转型。专注 AI 在垂直行业的真实落地，不为 AI 而 AI。
lead.en: Started as a product manager at Ouyarui New Materials. Over 4 years, transitioned into AI PM with a focus on real-world vertical-AI deployment — never AI for AI's sake.

title.zh: AI 产品经理 · 欧亚瑞新材料（碳纤维汽车、摩托车零部件）
title.en: AI Product Manager · Ouyarui New Materials (Carbon Fiber Auto/Moto Parts)

bullets.zh: 主导碳纤维零部件 AI 质检辅助系统 0→1：基于商汤视觉 AI + 自建 1200+ 张缺陷样本图，设计 AI+人工协同方案（置信度 > 80% 判缺陷，50%-80% 标疑似）。上线后整体质检效率 +40%（日均 500→700 件），漏检率从 8% 降至 2%，人工工作量 −30%。
bullets.en: Led the 0→1 of an AI-assisted QC system for carbon fiber parts. Built on SenseTime vision AI + 1,200 in-house defect samples. Designed an AI+human hybrid (confidence >80% = defect, 50–80% = flagged for review). Post-launch: QC efficiency +40% (500→700 parts/day), miss rate 8% → 2%, manual workload −30%.

bullets.zh: 搭建内部销售知识库 RAG 助手：整合 200+ 产品文档/报价/历史询盘，Claude API + Pinecone 向量库，定义 Prompt 模板与召回策略。新销售上手周期从 2 周缩短到 3 天，常见问题响应从 30 分钟降至 2 分钟，覆盖率 95% / 准确率 92%，销售满意度 3.2 → 4.5/5。
bullets.en: Built an internal sales RAG knowledge base: 200+ docs / pricing / inquiry history with Claude API + Pinecone. Defined prompt templates and retrieval strategy. Sales onboarding cut from 2 weeks to 3 days; common-question response 30min → 2min; 95% coverage, 92% accuracy; sales satisfaction 3.2 → 4.5/5.

bullets.zh: 设计碳纤维原材料智能采购建议系统：基于 3 年订单（12000+ 条）+ 汇率 + 物流 + 车展档期，用 Prophet 时序模型生成 90 天需求曲线 + 采购建议。库存周转 60 → 42 天（−30%），缺货导致订单延期月均 8 → 2 次（−75%），释放现金流约 ¥200 万。
bullets.en: Designed a smart purchasing recommendation system: 3 years of orders (12K+ rows) + FX + logistics + auto-show seasonality. Prophet time-series forecasts 90-day demand. Inventory turnover 60 → 42 days (−30%), stockout-driven delays 8 → 2 per month (−75%), ~¥2M cash flow released.

bullets.zh: 负责碳纤维汽车 / 摩托车零部件产品线（车身覆盖件 / 整流罩 / 排气管等 200+ SKU）；主导美国品牌 0→1 搭建，3 年内年销售额突破 $5M。
bullets.en: Owned the carbon fiber auto/moto parts product line (200+ SKUs: body kits, fairings, exhausts). Led the 0→1 of the US brand, scaling to $5M+ annual sales in 3 years.

bullets.zh: 管理国内外新媒体运营（小红书 / 抖音 / 公众号 / Facebook / Instagram）+ 阿里国际站产品上架；带 1 剪辑 + 1 运营助手月均产出 50+ 条内容；阿里国际站询盘转化率 +35%，新媒体粉丝累计 10 万+。
bullets.en: Ran cross-platform social media (Xiaohongshu / Douyin / WeChat / Facebook / Instagram) and Alibaba.com listings. Led a team of 1 editor + 1 ops assistant producing 50+ pieces/month. Alibaba inquiry conversion +35%, 100K+ social followers.

lead.zh: 欢迎来聊：AI 产品共创、垂直行业 AI 落地、制造业 AI 转型经验。邮件最稳，微信最快。
lead.en: Always open for: AI product co-creation, vertical AI deployment, manufacturing AI transition. Email is most reliable; WeChat fastest.

a.zh: 我是李金珂，AI 产品经理。
a.en: I'm Li Jinke, AI Product Manager.

a.zh: 4 年制造业产品经验 + 2024 年底转型 AI 产品。专注垂直行业 AI 真实落地：质检、知识库、供应链预测。
a.en: 4 years in manufacturing product + AI transition in late 2024. Focused on vertical AI deployment: QC, RAG knowledge base, supply chain forecasting.

a.zh: 信奉「AI 不是为了 AI 而 AI」—— 这个网站本身也是我亲手做的。
a.en: I don't do AI for AI's sake. This site itself is one of my hands-on outputs.

a.zh: 2) 销售内部 RAG 知识库（Claude + Pinecone），新人上手 2 周 → 3 天。
a.en: 2) Internal sales RAG knowledge base (Claude + Pinecone), onboarding 2 weeks → 3 days.

a.zh: 3) 时序预测采购建议（Prophet），库存周转 −30%，缺货 −75%。
a.en: 3) Time-series purchasing recommendation (Prophet), inventory turnover −30%, stockouts −75%.

a.zh: 当然，对外标签就是 OPEN to Collab 🤝
尤其欢迎：制造业 / B 端 AI 落地、RAG 知识库、AI + 人工协同方案。
a.en: Especially: manufacturing/B2B AI deployment, RAG knowledge bases, AI+human hybrid systems.

a.zh: 发邮件最快：hi@lijinke.com，简单说清楚背景和想法就行。
a.en: Email me: hi@lijinke.com — just share your context and idea briefly.
Email is most reliable, WeChat is fastest.

q.zh: 怎么入门 AI 产品?
q.en: How to get into AI Product?

a.zh: 我自己是 4 年制造业 PM 转过来的，体感：少看课，多做小项目。
a.en: I transitioned from 4 years of manufacturing PM. My take: less courseware, more small projects.

a.zh: 路径：先用 ChatGPT/Claude 把日常一件事自动化掉 → 再用 API 把它做成「别人也能用」的产品 → 在过程中补 LLM / Agent / Prompt / RAG 的知识。
a.en: Path: automate one daily task with ChatGPT/Claude → ship it as a product others can use via API → pick up LLM/Agent/Prompt/RAG along the way.
Want to go deeper? Email me.
